purpose: functional verification of per-role Redis ACLs on a real KVM node; no performance comparison

cases.name: the sandbox booted on KVM (no Tcg)
the default user is off: an unauthenticated client can do nothing
the node (as hv2-node) joined and the control plane (as hv2-control-plane) lists it live
a managed key creates a sandbox through the control plane; it boots on the node
a command runs in it through the control plane
the sandbox is deleted through the control plane (the node removes its records)
the managed key works before revocation
(harness) the key's sealed record is in Redis, as read by the admin
the control plane revokes the key (DELETE /keys/{id})
the revoked key is 401
(harness) the revocation record exists in Redis
as hv2-node, HDEL tombstone is refused

detail.reply: NOPERM No permissions to access a key

cases.name: as hv2-node, DEL tombstone hash is refused

detail.reply: NOPERM No permissions to access a key

cases.name: as hv2-node, HSET old key record back is refused

detail.reply: NOPERM No permissions to access a key

cases.name: as hv2-node, HGET key record (even a read) is refused

detail.reply: NOPERM No permissions to access a key

cases.name: as hv2-node, HGETALL tombstones (even a read) is refused

detail.reply: NOPERM No permissions to access a key

cases.name: as hv2-node, Lua HDEL tombstone is refused

detail.reply: NOPERM No permissions to access a key

cases.name: as hv2-node, Lua HSET old key record is refused

detail.reply: NOPERM No permissions to access a key

cases.name: as hv2-node, FLUSHALL is refused

detail.reply: NOPERM User hv2-node has no permissions to run the 'flushall' command

cases.name: as hv2-node, KEYS * is refused

detail.reply: NOPERM User hv2-node has no permissions to run the 'keys' command

cases.name: as hv2-gateway, HDEL tombstone is refused

detail.reply: NOPERM User hv2-gateway has no permissions to run the 'hdel' command

cases.name: as hv2-gateway, DEL tombstone hash is refused

detail.reply: NOPERM User hv2-gateway has no permissions to run the 'del' command

cases.name: as hv2-gateway, HSET old key record back is refused

detail.reply: NOPERM User hv2-gateway has no permissions to run the 'hset' command

cases.name: (harness) the tombstone is still there afterwards
the revoked key is still 401 after the node-user attacks
as hv2-node, writing its own families (environments) is allowed
as hv2-gateway, reading nodes is allowed
as hv2-gateway, writing nodes is refused

detail.reply: NOPERM User hv2-gateway has no permissions to run the 'sadd' command

cases.name: as hv2-gateway, a family it does not use is refused

detail.reply: NOPERM No permissions to access a key

cases.name: as hv2-gateway, a Lua script that writes is refused

detail.reply: NOPERM No permissions to access a key

cases.name: (control) a second key is revoked and is 401
(control) as the legacy shared user the same HDEL and HSET succeed
(control) the revoked key answers 200 again: the residual was real without role ACLs
the node log has no NOPERM
the control log has no NOPERM
no password or key appears in any service log
